newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan may let three airlines fly to Lahore.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan may let three airlines fly to Lahore.

text.p: Pakistan may let three foreign airlines fly to Lahore, the Punjab provincial capital, Defence Minister Aftab Shaaban Meerani said on Monday.

The official APP news agency quoted him as saying that KLM-Royal Dutch Airlines, Dubai-based Emirates Airlines and Bahrain-based Gulf Air could be granted traffic rights for Lahore under bilateral agreements. He gave no details.
Meerani also told reporters in Karachi that there were plans to build another runway at the city's airport, which handles most of Pakistan's air traffic. He did not elaborate.
